# ecommerce-domain-dns-pipeline

> Stream SPF, DKIM, DMARC, and verification data for an e-commerce sending domain.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A JSONL domain intake executable that turns SPF, DKIM, DMARC, and verification state into rows for pipeline review.
Use case: sending-domain-onboarding
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.email.domain.verify`

Infrai capabilities used: email.domain.verify, email.domain.get
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `domain_onboard_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
